trophies.guide: This platinum pops by itself once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no extra task to chase. Treat it as the finish line of the whole atlas: story first, then the 100% checklist, then stranger strands and the last odd jobs. Expect roughly 200 to 300 hours in total.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and see it through to the end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally while you learn the controls and meet Jason and Lucia. Nothing here can be missed, and no side task is needed first.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1, ending when the story rolls into Chapter 2 with the mission What’s in the Bag? Just follow the pink main-mission markers on the map. One warning: do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason’s house before this chapter ends, or Positive Mental Attitude may be lost.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 2’s main missions until the story moves into Chapter 3 with Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is where you unlock switching between Jason and Lucia after the mission Coffee Break, which opens up partner activities and most of the free-roam trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 3’s main missions until the story crosses into Chapter 4, starting with the missions Ocean Beach and Another Life. Along the way you unlock the Key Cloner, jewelry robberies and Payday Loans jobs, which feed several later trophies, so take the side calls as they come.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4’s main missions, closing with Starting From Zero. By now the big robbery systems are open: bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter, since there is no mission replay if you want a safety net.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission, which closes out Chapter 4 in Starting From Zero. This is the last story beat, so it arrives on its own once you finish the campaign. After the credits you keep free-roam access to all of Leonida, and the 100% checklist unlocks for the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so just follow the main path and it pops when the mission ends. No preparation or side progress is needed, and it cannot be missed as long as you finish the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a big set-piece job on the main path, so it unlocks by playing the story normally. Use it as a milestone: after this heist, much of the late-game robbery content starts opening up around Vice City.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child’s Play. Like the other mission trophies it pops automatically at the end of the mission, with no extra objective to watch for. Keep pushing the main story and it arrives in the back half of the campaign.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It is a story mission, so no special setup is required: follow the main-mission markers until the mission ends and the trophy pops. It sits in the same late-story stretch as the other Chapter 4 mission trophies.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It pops when the mission ends, so just play the story through. If you liked the airport, remember it later: the Catch Me If You Can trophy also lives at VCIA.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Despite the chapter numbering in some guides, this is the late-campaign mission that carries the trophy, and it pops automatically at the mission’s end. After it, only the finale stands between you and free-roam cleanup.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist, found under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion once the story ends. Progress made during the story already counts. The list is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and many collectibles only ask for a share, such as 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges and 15 of 18 meditations.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida, mixing the four kinds freely: 130 Stunt Jumps off ramps and jumps, 202 Under the Bridges flights under bridges, 40 Knife Flights threading between tall buildings, and 25 Base Jumps with parachute checkpoints. Under the Bridges runs are the quickest to farm. The 100% checklist later asks for 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or drone race, and performing a stunt. Track them under Progress, Activities. Most arrive naturally during the story and map exploration, so check the list late and mop up whichever type is still at zero.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting ranges around Leonida. Each range holds a few timed challenges with different weapons, and gold means beating a score or time bar, not just finishing. Practice one weapon at a time, use the range’s own leaderboard target as your pace, and revisit ranges as your Focus stat grows.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations, covering 42 races in total. Each location hosts several timed drone courses; winning one race at a location ticks it off. Learn the gates on a slow first run, then push for the win, and use the in-game drone race list to see which locations are still missing.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win any 20 of the 40 unique races around Leonida. Each distinct race counts once, so do not repeat the same course. Pick short street circuits first, learn their corners, and use a well-upgraded car. The 100% checklist later wants 30 wins, so the trophy is a milestone on the way there.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, wait for his text message marking a fishing spot west of Key Lento, then follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge. Keep your line tension steady, reel in bursts, and do not let the fish snap the line.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, and Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end once, not clear every side challenge.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy’s five quests as Lucia, ending with Puff Puff Pass. The line starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls Lucia and texts her address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain in three parts, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear all 7 shipwrecks for Kenton. His line opens in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams; he later calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure chests on the map, so dive each wreck, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the sea floor, and bring it back. He may go quiet during Chapter 1, but he returns later, so nothing is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy’s five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes. The line is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay open after the story ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers and Freaks strands. Only certain stranger lines count; the big named questlines such as Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters include Kirk’s Skunk Ape hunt (Search for the Skunk Ape, tree effigies, and helping Kirk find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle’s farm jobs, Yago’s street-racing mentorship, and Pilot Pete’s delivery runs. Strangers stay on the map after the story, so finish them in free roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver the sports cars on Randy’s wish list, a list of 16 cars that opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, then drive each one back to his garage in west Vice City in good condition for a better payout. The list includes the Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone’s line as Jason, which opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City: destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, and once enough are gone Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down. That final quest is the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 meditations across 10 locations. Each free-roam spot can be done once as Jason and once as Lucia after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, which is how the count reaches 18, and the final Ascent meditation on Mount Kalaga only appears once the others are done. The one missable session is the first: the morning after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason’s house, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work through Bret Vogel’s hunting line, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break when Jason gets Bret’s text marking the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animal he asks for and bring it back to him as Jason. His first quest also hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in themed sets, and a finished set is what counts, not a raw card total. Hunt set by set rather than grabbing cards at random: pick one set, clear its locations from the map, and move on. The in-game collections menu shows which sets are complete and which cards are still missing.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding up on the d-pad and R1 while looking at landmarks, curiosities and sculptures around Leonida. There are more than 100 in the world, so any 100 count. Make it a habit from Chapter 1: scan every new place you pass, and the trophy lands on its own long before you start hunting the last few.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges, which are small skill feats tracked under Progress, Challenges. Most of them land naturally while you work on other trophies, so leave this one late, then pick the easiest unfinished ones. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so the trophy is a waypoint on the way to that bigger goal.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner by holding right on the d-pad and pressing triangle. Cause enough chaos to reach 4 stars, then break away on a fast motorcycle; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape because helicopters lose you there. It also tends to pop naturally while robbing bank vaults.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Call your partner first, then hit three robbery targets, green icons on the map, while staying wanted the whole time. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items, and loot properly in each shop. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once they are open.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app, holding up on the d-pad and then R1 while looking at a vehicle. You do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch. The 100% checklist later wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy arrives on the way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus, triggered with L3 plus R3 while aiming. It slows time and drains the purple focus bar, so the window is short. Eat or drink to top up focus, use Adrenaline to stretch it, wear body armor, and pick a fight with a group of gang members at an illegal operation. Use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556, and note the trophy does not seem to count police, soldiers or civilians.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport, not one parked on the open airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, board, get to the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off, and fly about 1 kilometre away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it fires.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank, and fire the cannon at enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy military resistance on the way in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently opening alarmed back doors. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage, and disable the alarm before leaving. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot, and the trophy pops shortly after you walk out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is, which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and carry the cash out with your partner. After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each to mark more vans. Each vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to break the search. There are 8 vaults in total, and the 100% checklist wants them all.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The surest route is the same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults, That’s Where The Money Is: tailing the truck to a bank and robbing its vault counts. You can also do it earlier in free roam by blocking a truck near a bank, planting a sticky bomb on its back door, blowing it open, and escaping the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani’s shop after his jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida by clearing the fog from the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is fully visible. Work county by county so no corner is missed, and remember that unfogging also reveals activity icons and side content for other trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs, which shows how many of its operations you have robbed. The 100% checklist wants all 39, so this trophy lands early on that road.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Hotel on Ocean Beach, take the lift up to the rooftop bar, and order the Apple Martini, which costs $10. Drink it while standing at the bar with the ocean view in front of you, and the trophy pops. The hotel is the pink-neon Art Deco building on the Ocean Drive strip, and the bar is signposted as the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: this is the method guides are reporting, and it still needs a second confirmation. Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, using the Key Cloner unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS, then drive it straight out through the showroom window. The pop is slightly delayed and fires once you are out on the street. Only that blue Banshee is reported to work, as a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the Kolt and Associates gang operations. You first visit it during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The valuables are a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and a safe in the north-east hallway, opened with code 0300 or sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and the robbery icon respawns later if you missed one.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Strength under the character menu for each of them. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when switching characters unlocks. Buy a fitness club membership, always train with your partner called over, and while one character works out the other trains automatically, doubling progress. Home workouts also count after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The trophy list itself tracks the count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, and a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Stealthy robberies, clean escapes and destroying evidence push you toward Professional; limb shots toward Hardened; killing toward Violent and then Psycho. It builds passively across every robbery and fight, so leave it until last and only farm it then if you are short.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: this is the method guides are reporting, and it still needs a second confirmation. During the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. Later, after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer, return to the same Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, alone as Lucia. Aim at the teller, deal with security, break through the door, empty the 3 cash drawers, and escape on foot, not in a vehicle. The pop is delayed until you are clear of the police search area.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. After Chapter 1, go alone at night, after 2am, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Look for a stranded car with flashing headlights, then follow the trail it points to into the woods toward a blue light. The UFO drops a woman it was lifting; talk to her, offer to help, and fetch her car from the roadside, at which point the beam takes you instead and the trophy pops. The car does not always spawn, so drive away and return if it is not there.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: this is the method guides are reporting, and it still needs a second confirmation. Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with the melee button within 60 seconds, in a crowded spot such as Vice City or Ocean Beach. The name is a bowling joke, but no bowling is involved: it is a drive-by kicking spree on two wheels, so pick a busy pavement, keep your speed steady, and chain the kicks without stopping.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across many robberies, not in one trip, and bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 each, so it builds fast once vaults are open.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. It counts cumulatively, so every purchase helps, but the fastest route is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. By the time you have bought weapons, armor and upgrades for the other trophies, the total is usually close; top it up with a big mod-shop visit if needed.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which cost $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone. Buy them through the app, not in person. Robberies are the quickest money source, especially the higher-value jobs that open in Chapters 3 and 4, so save this one until your cash is healthy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which installs on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Each garage you own adds parking spots for registrations, so buy garages first. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register in his garage, or register at a Pay ’n’ Spray once Chapter 3 lets you handle tracked cars. Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
